set_fader_label.name: Set fader label
set_fader_label.description: Sets the text and icon on a fader's display (full-size GoXLR only).

fader.name: Fader
fader.description: The fader, from left to right: A, B, C or D.

text.name: Text
text.description: The text, about 11 characters fit. Leave it out to keep the current text.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: An icon file from GoXLR Utility's icons folder. Leave it out to keep the current icon, or empty to remove it.
